headline_summary: Denver's secondary is gutted for TNF: CB1 Pat Surtain II and S Talanoa Hufanga are Out and CB Riley Moss is Questionable, with NFL receiving leader Jaxon Smith-Njigba coming to town.
Both middles are open: Seattle is without WILL Drake Thomas (Tyrice Knight starts) and Denver is without robber safety Hufanga. Watch Evan Engram and AJ Barner.
Baker Mayfield (dislocated throwing thumb) is projected out, with rookie Jalon Daniels expected to start into a ~21 mph Tampa wind forecast.
Eagles skill players are dropping: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith both missed Wednesday practice, and Philadelphia backs ran 16 times for 20 yards without Barkley in Week 5.
Lamar Jackson (ankle) missed Wednesday practice; Schefter calls his chance to play 'realistic.' Tyler Huntley is on standby.

matchup_spotlights.title: JSN vs. the Broncos' Backup Secondary
matchup_spotlights.body: The NFL's leading receiver (583 yards, 7 TDs) visits Mile High with no Surtain, no Hufanga and maybe no Moss. Vance Joseph promises a man/zone mix and a 'plan,' but Seattle moves JSN everywhere. @theplayerprops_ has him at 75+ yards and 5+ catches in all five games.

matchup_spotlights.title: Middle-of-Field Battle
matchup_spotlights.body: Both teams are down a middle-of-field defender. Seattle loses WILL Drake Thomas (Tyrice Knight steps in); Denver loses robber safety Hufanga. That's an opening for the tight ends: Evan Engram, Sean Payton's self-described 'mismatch-type' Joker, and AJ Barner, Darnold's checkdown. RJ Harvey is the wild card: 10 catches in Week 4, one target in Week 5.

matchup_spotlights.title: Bo Knows TDs (Mostly)
matchup_spotlights.body: Bo Nix has a passing TD in all 5 games (@theplayerprops_), but his yardage has been streaky: 131, 288, 186, 214, 123. Against Seattle's No. 2 EPA defense, SI leans Nix under 202.5 passing yards.

matchup_spotlights.title: Rookie, Wind and Steel
matchup_spotlights.body: Mayfield's dislocated throwing thumb means Jalon Daniels likely makes his third start (19/25, 189 yards, 1 TD last week), with roughly 21 mph sustained wind forecast at Raymond James. Daniels' legs are the safer bet than his arm.
